# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde (Lucy) Pembroke is an eleven-year-old girl who possesses an extremely lovely appearance with rosy cheeks, black hair, and black eyes.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040)_

## Personality

Isolde is a very nice, good, and intelligent young girl. She loves reading books and spends a great deal of time engrossed in them, though she also enjoys playing outdoors. She has an open, cheerful disposition, frequently bursting into laughter, and is friendly and receptive to making commitments of lifelong companionship.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 c12 P28](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0028), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036)_

## Traits

- Fond of reading  <sub>[v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>
- Good-natured and intelligent  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040)</sub>
- Prone to laughter  <sub>[v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036)</sub>

## Abilities

- Singing ('Nelly in the Hazel Dell')  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>

## Goals

- To have a playmate and bosom friend to share games and secrets with  <sub>[v1 c8 P36](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0036), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 c12 P28](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0028)</sub>

## History

Isolde Pembroke lived at Pear Hill near Pembroke's Pond with her parents and sisters. After returning from a visit to her aunt in Delford, she met Nell Harcourt in the family garden at the suggestion of her mother. The two girls quickly hit it off and swore a solemn vow of lifelong friendship over the garden path. Isolde accompanied Nell and Thirza Abernethy partway home to Grey Shutters and shared chocolates given by Obed. She later constructed a playhouse called Larkrise in a nearby birch grove with Nell, where they played with china fragments and a 'fairy glass'. Isolde also offered to teach Nell songs and share books with her.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P55](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0055), [v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P23](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0023), [v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 c12 P38](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0038), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c12 P45](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0045)_

> Well, I suppose that’s true. I am so happy that you have moved to Grey Shutters. Having a companion to play with will be wonderful. No other girls reside close enough for us to play together, and none of my sisters are old enough.  <sub>[v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>
